verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a prebuilt n8n, Zapier or other no-code connector for Browserbase. The documented webhooks, OpenAPI spec, SDK, MCP server and CLI are developer building blocks a user could wire up themselves, not a prebuilt connector, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can connect the scraping API to no-code automation platforms like n8n or Zapier through a prebuilt connector
